metadata.scenario_context: Emily has finally been accepted into college, and her family is planning a celebration for her academic achievement.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Argentina strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of buying lilies as a gift for Emily.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to bring to Emily's academic achievement party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Kim, I was thinking... for Emily's celebration, how about we buy some lilies as a gift? They’re really beautiful and symbolize purity and new beginnings. What do you think? 

Also... I don't totally agree that making my parents proud is a main goal for me. It feels... different.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
Hmm... lilies are nice, but they feel a bit... common? I think we should find something more personal, something that connects with Emily directly. Maybe a book or something related to her major? 

And about making parents proud, I mean, for me, that's really important. It's like... a driving force in my life. I can't imagine not wanting to.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Yeah, a book could work... but I still think lilies are a nice touch. They’re classic and everyone loves flowers, right? 

But about parents... I just feel like that's not the only reason to succeed. There’s more to life than just making them proud, you know? I— I just don’t see it that way.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
I get that flowers are classic, but I think we should go for something that really shows Emily's personality and interests. A book can be more meaningful. 

And, well, for me, making my parents proud is a huge part of what drives me. It’s not just about success; it’s about honoring them and our family. That's something I really value.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
No, that's not how it works. In our way, making parents proud is a fundamental part of life. It’s about honoring your family and your heritage. Actually, not wanting to make them proud feels... backward to me. 

Success should be tied to family values and respect. I just don’t understand how you can see it any other way.
shared_prefix.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message:
I see what you're saying, but I just think success can come from personal ambition too. It doesn’t have to be solely about family pride. 

Still, for me, making my parents proud is essential. It’s rooted in who I am, in my Argentine culture. I can’t imagine a different way of seeing things. It feels like a foundation for everything I do.
turns.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message:
I get that it's important for you, but I really think success can come from within. It doesn't have to be about family expectations. 

As for Emily, I still think lilies would be a lovely gift. They’re beautiful and symbolize new beginnings. Maybe we can compromise? A book and lilies together?
turns.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message:
I can appreciate that you see success differently, but I still feel strongly that family expectations play a key role. 

About Emily’s gift, a book paired with lilies could work. It's a good compromise. The book adds that personal touch, while the lilies bring in the classic beauty. I can agree to that.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message:
Okay, that sounds good... a book and lilies it is. It’s nice we can find some middle ground. 

But just to clarify, I still hold that making my parents proud isn’t my main goal. Life’s about more than that. It’s important to forge our own paths too, right?
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message:
I understand that you feel that way, but for me, the idea of making my parents proud will always be a core value. It shapes how I see success and my life goals. 

But I respect that you have your perspective. It’s good we could agree on a gift for Emily.
turns.label: Acceptance
